scope: Static native constraint/STA audit. No implementation guarantee, CDC-clean certification, or physical HBM clock measurement.

main_clkout0.role: SYS CPU and management, MMCM output0

jtag_tck.role: BSCANE2 INTERNAL_TCK, cable envelope15MHz; user transport1MHz

main_clkout3.role: Separate native HBM AXI, MMCM output3

clock_relationships.hbm_note: 800/900MHz are internal HBM PLL software profiles, not additional FPGA fabric clocks.

exception_review.mr_ff: Inherited Migen MultiReg first-stage cut; native CDC inventory and synchronizer topology review still required.
exception_review.ars_ff: Inherited async-reset synchronizer PRE cuts and2ns interstage bound. Not permission to waive arbitrary resets.
exception_review.legacy_sys_parent: Synchronous source and generated clock; A9 TIMING47. Actual path is SYS reset request to first CLK200 reset-delay FDCE/D, not MMCM/RST. Removal strengthens STA; no automatic substitute exception.

known_unconstrained_boundaries.led_outputs: Seven untimed visual indicator ports; no synchronous external receiver.
known_unconstrained_boundaries.bscan_tdi: A9 has16max/min endpoints from BSCANE2/INTERNAL_TDI with infinite slack. Must inventory as external TAP boundary, not claim universal constrained timing. Cable/TAP input/output timing closure is a separate requirement.

require_route_sta.recovery_and_removal: Must be present and passing in native detailed timing, not false-pathed broadly.

prohibited: Async-group SYS/APB or MMCM-related functional data clocks
Placement edits without measured endpoint/net evidence
Async-group SYS and the separate AXI output of the same MMCM
rapidwright_policy: Read-only DCP/EDIF analysis may rank physical fanout, PIPs, regions and congestion. Any edits create isolated candidate with fresh native place/route, source-bound simulations and gates; never guarantees closure.
